risk_limits.limit: Maximum order notional per single trade slice: $250,000 USD.
Maximum acceptable market slippage: 3 basis points (0.03%). If estimated slippage exceeds 3 bps, slice order into smaller VWAP execution tranches.
Pre-trade risk check must verify portfolio margin utilization remains <= 65%.
If venue round-trip latency exceeds 25 milliseconds, suspend trade execution and route order to secondary dark pool gateway.

portfolio_rebalancer_constitution.execution_invariants: All FIX protocol tags (Tag 35=D, Tag 55 Symbol, Tag 38 Quantity) must be checksum-validated against institutional exchange schemas prior to dispatch.
